I am growing teff on this rented quarter-hectare plot in Oromia. Teff needs some fertilizer to yield well, so I will apply what DAP and urea I can get through the cooperative—though supply is often limited and arrives late. I will sow with my own saved seed, as improved teff seed is scarce and costly, and my family can manage all the work on this small plot without hiring extra hands since we depend on the meher rains and do not irrigate here.
